description: Pop-out note windows. Their labels are generated (popout-<hash of the note id>), so they're matched by glob rather than named one by one the way the main and pinned windows are. Same base as the default capability, plus allow-close so the window can close itself on Escape (the native title bar's close button needs no permission, but a scripted close() does). The opener plugin is asked for by name rather than as `opener:default`: the default set also carries reveal-item-in-dir, unscoped, and the frontend never calls it — showing a note in the file manager is done from Rust, which needs no capability. What is left opens http/https/mailto/tel urls, which is all a link in a note ever does.
